aria-hidden only hides content from assistive tech, not visually — it must still be rendered

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>visible</p><div aria-hidden="true">still shown</div><p>also visible</p>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result)

main()
```
